current.text: Chris Cenac Jr. is a rookie from the 2026 draft class.
He is probably not going to contribute in fantasy this season.
In a dynasty re-rank of the 2026 rookie class, he was ranked 22nd.
Boston is very deep, with at least 12 rotation-level players. Its projected starting five and five-man bench rotation do not include Cenac.
He is not a draft target in our 144-player auction.

durable.text: He rarely blocked shots in college. His block rate there was low for his size and athleticism.
He averaged 2.8 blocks per game in Summer League. That answered some of the concerns about his shot blocking.
